title: Minimum Factorization
goal: Find the smallest positive 32-bit integer whose decimal digits multiply to num.
strategy: Factor the target using digits nine down to two, which minimizes the number of digits. Reverse the collected digits into increasing order to minimize the integer. A leftover factor or overflow makes the answer impossible.
